Demo dataset for the datagoodr vignettes

dg_demo.Rd

A small synthetic dataset with one column per data type, so each vignette can build a real DGF and render a real profile for every reporting style. Values are deliberately in their messy "as-entered" form (dates as `M/D/YYYY`, a boolean as `yes`/`no`, a zero-padded FIPS code) so the typing and stabilization steps have something to do.

Usage

dg_demo

Format

A data frame with 60 rows and 6 variables:

event_date

character; a calendar date written `M/D/YYYY` (temporal).

region

character; one of four regions (categorical).

is_active

character; `"yes"`/`"no"`, recoded to logical (boolean).

revenue

numeric; a right-skewed dollar amount (number).

county_fips

character; a zero-padded 5-digit county FIPS (identifier).

notes

character; short free-text notes (text).

Source

Generated by `data-raw/dg_demo.R`.
